# Section

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

An invisible, zero-height named anchor. When rendered, a Section records the 1-based page number on which it sits against its `AnchorId` in the shared `TocEntries` registry, so that a `SectionLink` can jump to it and a `PageNumberOf` can print "see page 42".

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `ElementBase`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new Section(string anchorId)
```

## Properties

- [`AnchorId`](#anchorid): The unique anchor identifier.
- [`CaptureType`](#capturetype): Stable node name for the layout snapshot tree.

### `AnchorId`

```csharp
string AnchorId { get; }
```

*read-only*

The unique anchor identifier. A `SectionLink` or `PageNumberOf` referencing this id resolves to the page this Section rendered on.

### `CaptureType`

```csharp
string CaptureType { get; }
```

*read-only*

Stable node name for the layout snapshot tree.
